title: Public Preview: Azure SQL Managed Instance mirroring to Microsoft Fabric

content.text:
You can now use mirroring to easily replicate Azure SQL Managed Instance data to Microsoft Fabric. Mirroring replicates your data in near real-time directly into Fabric OneLake. Using mirroring helps you avoid complex Extract Transform Load (ETL) processes and reduce your total cost of ownership while gaining faster time to insights. Fabric unlocks powerful business intelligence, artificial intelligence, data engineering, data science, and data sharing scenarios.
Learn more.
